note: Animation-only candidate. Original idle, talk and other non-walk rows were copied pixel-for-pixel. Four independent walk directions: 8 frames x 75ms; verify alternating feet, natural counter-swinging arms, map camera angle and in-game scale before integration.

batchReview.criteria: Accept a direction only when frames 1 and 5 clearly exchange lead legs and counter-swinging arms, held props stay fixed, facing is correct, and no cell bleed or clipping is visible.

down.arms: does not meet the required clearly opposite counter-swing at frames 1 and 5
